groups.name: MovieSum (2,200 film screenplays, XML-structured, from IMSDb)
groups.licence: Dataset card: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Saxena and Keller, ACL Findings 2024). The screenplays are third-party copyrighted works; non-commercial local analysis only.
groups.method: 3 jsonl files (train, val, test) downloaded once; IMDb ids in the dataset

groups.name: SummScreen, ForeverDreaming split (4,348 TV episode transcripts)
groups.licence: The HF mirror carries no licence field. Source transcripts are fan-written on transcripts.foreverdreaming.org (robots.txt: Allow /). The shows are third-party copyrighted works; local analysis only.
groups.robots: huggingface.co allows crawling; foreverdreaming.org robots.txt: User-agent * Allow /.
groups.method: fd_train, fd_dev, fd_test json files downloaded once

groups.name: SummScreen, TVMegaSite split (soap-opera transcripts with scene breaks; dev, test and every 6th train episode)
groups.licence: As summscreen. Soap operas (All My Children, As the World Turns, Bold and Beautiful, Days of Our Lives, General Hospital, Guiding Light, One Life to Live, Passions, Port Charles, Young and Restless) are third-party copyrighted works; local analysis only.
groups.method: tms_train, tms_dev, tms_test json files downloaded once and converted to jsonl locally

groups.name: OPUS OpenSubtitles v2018 raw XML, pt_br, random sample of files
groups.licence: OPUS OpenSubtitles (Lison and Tiedemann, LREC 2016), a research redistribution of opensubtitles.org subtitles; subtitle text is third-party copyrighted. Local analysis only; cue times and text never committed.
groups.robots: opus.nlpl.eu/robots.txt disallows only its own /opus/*.zip|gz|tar paths on that host; the files were read from object.pouta.csc.fi (CSC object storage) by HTTP range requests (0.15 s apart), not from the disallowed paths.
groups.method: zip central directory read by range request, files drawn at random (seeds 11, 21, 31), one file kept per IMDb title, IMDb type movie/tvMovie/video/tvEpisode/tvSeries/tvMiniSeries, span within 40-115% of IMDb runtime

groups.name: OPUS OpenSubtitles v2018 raw XML, pt_br, only titles whose original title is Brazilian (IMDb akas region BR, original title; episodes of such series)
groups.robots: As opus-ptbr; selection by the IMDb allow-list in scripts/cinema/build_native_ids.py (IMDb non-commercial title.akas and title.episode).
groups.method: as opus-ptbr, seed 41, restricted to the allow-list; native Portuguese dialogue, not translations

groups.name: OPUS OpenSubtitles v2018 raw XML, en, random sample of files
Brazilian pilot screenplays published as annexes of undergraduate theses (pdftotext -layout)
groups.licence: Institutional repository open-access items; the scripts belong to their authors. Local analysis only.
groups.robots: Each repository's robots.txt was not violated; single file fetches 3 s apart.
groups.method: PDF downloaded once, text extracted locally

attemptedNotUsed.what: Plinio Marcos, Obras teatrais vols 1-6 (Funarte PDFs)
attemptedNotUsed.outcome: host did not resolve in DNS from the build machine on 2026-11-11 and has no Wayback copy; nothing fetched. Still a good modern pt-BR stage source if it comes back (author died 1999, in copyright, local analysis only).
no free full-text copy found on a publicly reachable, non-piracy site; not fetched.

attemptedNotUsed.what: IMSDb, SimplyScripts, Daily Script and other script sites
attemptedNotUsed.outcome: not crawled: MovieSum already contains 2,200 IMSDb-derived, XML-structured screenplays, so no site was hit. robots.txt of simplyscripts.com and dailyscript.com permit crawling; imsdb.com serves no robots.txt.
not used: dialogue only (no directions, no cue times), nothing that MovieSum, SummScreen and subtitles do not already give.
searched: no Brazilian or Portuguese corpus. Not used.

attemptedNotUsed.what: Brazilian university repository PDFs of other pilot scripts (UnB, Aracati culture map)
attemptedNotUsed.outcome: TLS certificate verification failed on those hosts; verification was not bypassed, so they were not fetched. One thesis (UFPE) held no scene headings and was skipped.

attemptedNotUsed.what: Portuguese-language open datasets of telenovela or Brazilian film scripts on Hugging Face
attemptedNotUsed.outcome: searched with several queries (roteiro, novela, telenovela, pt-br dialogue): no script dataset found.
